result_text:
Template literals on a single line are now blanked like the other string literals, so JavaScript functions that differ only inside `` `...` `` are reported as one unit duplicate. I did not add a test for the new case, and I did not run your `Hello alpha` / `Hello beta` example. The existing `codeanalyzer` module tests ran with no failures reported.

The change is one line in `extraCleanContent` in `CStyleHeuristicUnitsExtractor.java`: `` replaceAll("`.*?`", "``") ``, placed right after the single-quote rule. That also covers `${...}` interpolations inside the literal. A difference in the code outside the backticks still keeps the units apart.

A template literal that spans several lines is not blanked, because `.` doesn't match newlines in that regex. I left that alone because collapsing lines would shift the line numbers used to map units back to the source.
